NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To choose your profile photo, upload your progress photos and, if you are a coach, the photos in your meal books.
NSMotionUsageDescription: To count the steps you take each day and add them to your nutrition plan, so you don't have to log them by hand.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: To write your payments, your training blocks and your tasks into your calendar. It only writes what you ask it to.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: To write your payments, your training blocks and your tasks into your calendar. It only writes what you ask it to.
